summary: Issue one Modbus TCP Function Code 16 request to write an ordered register sequence to one identified device.

required_fields.name: function_code
required_fields.notes: 16 for this versioned action type; the first-conduit projection enforces the value

required_fields.name: unit_id
required_fields.notes: Modbus unit identifier in the inclusive range 1 through 247

required_fields.name: start_address
required_fields.notes: Zero-based first register address as carried by the FC10 request

required_fields.name: quantity
required_fields.notes: Register count in the inclusive FC10 range 1 through 123

required_fields.name: values
required_fields.notes: Ordered array of quantity unsigned 16-bit register values; the first-conduit projection enforces element range and length

digest_notes: All eight fields are material. Site and device are taken verbatim from the relying party's pinned inventory. The MBAP transaction identifier is correlation-only and is excluded.
references: Modbus Application Protocol Specification V1.1b3, Section 6.12
